title: Wildfire forces evacuation of NASA's Deep Space Network complex in Spain
summary: The Deep Space Network is managed by NASA’s Space Communications and Navigation and NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Without the Madrid location, the Deep Space Network is down to one operational 70-meter radio antenna in Australia.
